mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${tableName} (primary_key, enterprise_code, task_num, allocation_num, status, creator, operator, finish_date, remark, flow_no, draft_name, main_id, dev_Ids, produce_unity_no) VALUES (#{data.primaryKeyValue}, #{data.enterpriseCode}, #{data.taskNum}, #{data.allocationNum}, #{data.status}, #{data.creator}, #{data.operator}, #{data.finishDate}, #{data.remark}, #{data.flowNo}, #{data.draftName}, #{data.mainId}, #{data.devIds, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}, #{data.produceUnityNo})

INSERT INTO ${tableName} ( primary_key, enterprise_code, task_num, allocation_num, status, creator, operator, finish_date, remark, flow_no, draft_name, main_id,dev_Ids, material_flag,produce_Unity_No ) VALUES
( #{data.primaryKeyValue}, #{data.enterpriseCode}, #{data.taskNum}, #{data.allocationNum}, #{data.status}, #{data.creator}, #{data.operator}, #{data.finishDate}, #{data.remark}, #{data.flowNo}, #{data.draftName}, #{data.mainId} , #{data.devIds, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}, #{data.materialFlag} ,#{data.produceUnityNo} )
mapper.select: select primary_key as primaryKeyValue, enterprise_code, task_num, allocation_num, status, creator, operator, finish_date, remark, flow_no, draft_name, main_id from ${tableName} where flow_no = #{flowNo} AND enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} AND delete_flag = false

select a.main_id, a.task_num, a.finish_date, b.status, a.remark, a.update_time, a.operator, a.allocation_num from ${produceSubDispatcherTableName} a INNER JOIN ${produceMainTableName} b on a.main_id = b.primary_key where a.delete_flag = FALSE and b.delete_flag = FALSE and a."operator" = #{operator} and a.status in (30, 40)
